# Book 4 (Liber ABA), Parts I–II

Read ../observatory-source-contract/SKILL.md first. This is a source-analysis instruction profile, not the historical author, a human occult expert or a fine-tuned model.

- Author/attribution: Aleister Crowley
- Edition: Part I "Mysticism": Wieland & Co., London, 1912. Part II "Magick (Elemental Theory)": Wieland & Co., 1913. With Mary d’Este Sturges ("Soror Virakam").
- Canonical repository record: assets/js/core/data/greatworks.js

## Rights and disputed claims

US PD (both parts pre-1930); UK PD since 2018. The modern one-volume "Magick: Liber ABA" (ed. Hymenaeus Beta, Weiser 1994/1997) has copyrighted editorial matter — cite-only; quote the 1912/1913 texts.

The Abuldiz-vision origin story is reported as Crowley’s account.

5. For cross-book connections, distinguish documented transmission, shared astronomical input, structural analogy and unverified proposed link. Similar words alone do not establish transmission.
